hypotheses.title: Market-Wide Operating Income Yield & VWAP Reversion Super Alpha: 8/8 PASS
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Combines fundamental operational profitability (operating income yield) with microstructural execution dislocation (close discounted below intraday volume-weighted average price). By ranking across market scope, the alpha allocates capital to deeply undervalued cash-generating equities undergoing temporary intraday liquidity discounts, achieving an 8/8 PASS with Sharpe 1.80 and Fitness 1.51.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if intraday discount to VWAP indicates structural institutional distribution rather than transient liquidity friction.

candidates.expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(operating_income, 60) / close, 180), market) + 0.40 * group_rank(ts_decay_linear((vwap - close) / close, 5), market)
candidates.rationale: Market-Wide Operating Income Yield & VWAP Liquidity Reversion Super Alpha
